rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for most or a majority of a group.

example.english: The majority of people support this plan.
example.traditional: 大部分人都支持呢個方案。
example.jyutping: daai6 bou6 fan6 jan4 dou1 zi1 ci4 ni1 go3 fong1 on3

rows.note: Use this when you need to state explicitly that the number is over 50%, rather than simply saying most.

example.english: A majority of people chose this plan in the vote.
example.traditional: 今次投票，過半數人都揀咗呢個方案。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 tau4 piu3 gwo3 bun3 sou3 jan4 dou1 gaan2 zo2 ni1 go3 fong1 on3

rows.note: Use this for an election majority expressed as the difference in votes between candidates or sides.

example.english: The majority in this election was only 300 votes.
example.traditional: 今次選舉嘅票數差距得三百票。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 syun2 geoi2 ge3 piu3 sou3 caa1 geoi6 dak1 saam1 baak3 piu3

rows.note: Use this for a parliamentary majority expressed as the number of seats separating the governing and opposing sides.

example.english: The governing party's majority is only two seats, so passing bills will be difficult.
example.traditional: 議席差距得兩席，執政黨要通過法案好難。
example.jyutping: ji5 zik6 caa1 geoi6 dak1 loeng5 zek6 zap1 zing3 dong2 jiu3 tung1 gwo3 faat3 on3 hou2 naan4
